dockerfile_lines: # The four gates shell out to a pinned TypeScript compiler, ESLint and two
# parse-only AST scripts. They are the product, not a dev convenience: a
# deployment that cannot compile its own output is a deployment that can only
# claim the conversion worked. So the image carries Node and the same pinned
# Installed to a fixed absolute path, because the folder a repository happens
# to be cloned into is not something an image can know. env.SANDBOX reads
# S2P_SANDBOX and finds it here. The lockfile is copied on its own first, so
# this layer is rebuilt only when the pinned versions actually change.

convert.description: One TypeScript Selenium file to Playwright: intake, recall, risk review, then up to three convert/validate/critic laps before the report. Send the file as text: source_text plus source_path as its name (e.g. LoginPage.ts), and context_text for already-converted companions. source_path/context_paths alone read that path on the SERVER filesystem instead, which only means anything when the server is your own machine. Also: output_path, refinement, ask_risks, user_id, remember, max_attempts.

suite.description: A whole Selenium folder: scan it, convert every file in dependency waves (the convert graph as a subgraph, fanned out with Send), then compile the finished tree as one project and write the report. Inputs: root (required), out_root, only.
